Keep any thin smoke below the skyline within the painted temple plateau only. Every pixel above the mountain and architectural silhouette must be flat pure #00ff00, including gaps between columns. Preserve the rest of IMAGE 1 exactly: same mountains, temple, haze, lighting, composition and 1536x1024 size. IMAGE 2 is the original canvas: its LEFT 256 columns are the immutable neighbour overlap; ensure the final LEFT 256 columns match IMAGE 2 exactly. Do not modify those original painted pixels. Retain seamless continuation at x=256. Hand-drawn painted 2D, tapered contours, clean violet painted planes and subtle warm upper-left rims, restrained texture. No characters, creatures, text, UI, borders, vignette or foreground cliff rim. Return ONE 1536x1024 PNG.
